description.zh-Hans: 每个人用自己那张嘴说话：行当、出身、念过多少书、什么年代什么地方，决定他开口是什么样。书里印了台词的人照书说；书里没写的人，后台车道替他写两句底样给守秘人当口吻参考——不是让他照念。
description.en: Everyone talks their own way: trade, class, schooling, era and place decide how a person sounds aloud. A book that prints someone's speech keeps it; for the people a book left silent a background lane writes two sample lines as the register the Keeper performs from — never a line to read out.

actor_profile_keys.label: sounds like
actor_profile_keys.ask: two short lines in this person's own words when the book prints their speech, one at ease and one under strain
